verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a travel booking product with per diem and policy status (ramp-docs-18, ramp-docs-19). Its CLI exposes a `transactions … trips` subcommand and a `travel` resource, and its MCP server enumerates `trips:read`/`trips:write` scopes, which suggests transactions are associated with trips. Card receipts are auto-captured and memos auto-filled on swipe (ramp-docs-8, ramp-docs-32). However, no evidence explicitly describes bookings, card spend and receipts automatically assembling into a single itinerary-linked trip report. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic trip-level grouping of bookings, card charges and receipts into one report, itinerary linkage details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
